note: Phase 8c Stage C-S retrieval and bundle parameters, fixed from the score distribution before any bundle was built or read (docs/research/8c-preregistration.md, Stage C-S).

units.window_rule: a unit with more than max_content_words content words is cut into ceil(n/max) consecutive windows of near-equal size

root_weight: idf = ln(N / df); df = number of indexed units (all corpora, pivots and partners) containing the root group; N = indexed units with >= 1 mapped root group
partner_rule: other branch; >= 2 shared root groups, >= 1 of them outside the 50 most frequent root groups; score = sum of idf over shared groups
floor_rule: floor = the 0.9 quantile of the best-partner score over all Stage C-S pivots that have a partner (Stage B's size rule); a pivot keeps its top-k partners scoring >= floor
null_model: null model: the same deduplicated units of every corpus, each content word's root-group set permuted among the content words of its corpus (seed 0); the same retrieval from the Stage C pivots
merge_rule: bundles in order of best partner score; a bundle whose pivot and >= 1 partner already sit in a kept bundle is merged into it (its other units added best first, cap 12 passages); else kept

decoys.rule: bundles in document order of their pivots; one in every consecutive block of 1/share drawn (seeded random), before slabs are packed; every non-pivot passage replaced by a unit of the same corpus, not in the bundle, sharing no root group outside the 50 most frequent with the pivot and at most one in all; matched on content-word count (within 25%, at least +-1) and mean root idf (within 10%, widened to 20%, 40%, any)

corpora.sga: Old Irish (CELT; Irish editions and journals, OCR)
corpora.mga: Middle Irish (CELT; Irish editions and journals, OCR)
corpora.cy: Middle Welsh (Skene; Evans and Rhŷs & Evans editions; journals, OCR)
corpora.ga-early: Early Modern Irish (CELT; Irish editions and journals, OCR)
corpora.vuk: Serbian epic and lyric songs (Vuk Karadžić, sr.wikisource)
corpora.byliny: Russian byliny (Kirsha Danilov, Rybnikov, Hilferding, Kireevsky)
corpora.dainos: Lithuanian dainos (Rhesa, Nesselmann, Schleicher, Leskien-Brugmann, Bartsch, Juškevič; OCR)
corpora.grc: Greek poetry and prose to 300 BC (GLAUx)
corpora.ang: Old English poetry (Beowulf, Gutenberg; Grein 1857-58, OCR)
corpora.lv: Latvian dainas (quotations in a book on the dainas, OCR)

glaux_rule: Stage B: all GLAUx texts with ENDDATE <= -300; Stage C adds: GLAUx texts with ENDDATE > -300 and a stated open licence (SOURCE_LICENSE not 'NA' / 'OpenEdition Books License'), every genre; Homer and the Septuagint (TLG 0527, translation literature) excluded; NC/ND texts carried with research_only
dcs_epic_rule: DCS Mahābhārata and Rāmāyaṇa (CC BY 4.0), DCS sentence; lemma mapping: the round-3 'av' table (same DCS lemma convention), else the live kaikki Sanskrit mapping, with the 'av' lemma errata
orv_rule: TOROT texts in Old Russian (language 'orv') composed before c. 1300 and original East Slavic writing: the Igor Tale, the chronicles (Primary, Kiev, Suzdal, First Novgorod), Russkaja pravda, the Statute of Vladimir, birchbark letters, colophons, charters and treaties to 1281. Left out: Church Slavonic ('chu') texts, the Uspenskij sbornik (largely translated hagiography), and everything later (Zadonshchina, Smolensk charter 1386, Pskov, Afanasij Nikitin, Domostroj, Avvakum, letters).
celtic_rule: raw/daughters/celtic-stageC/units.jsonl, units with dup_of null; Celtic lemmatizers with use_skeleton=False; tagged gloss tokens by their lemma (sga-glosses table)
low_mapped_rule: units with < 30% of content words mapped are pivots like the others (partners only through their mapped words)
thin_rule: thin corpora: partner-only corpora with < THIN_MAX_UNITS indexed units under the main rule; layer loosened to the whole native corpus, genre waived; Hittite unit = paragraph; up to THIN_SLOTS thin partners per pivot (best per thin corpus) from a separate search; thin floor = the FLOOR_Q quantile of the pivots' best thin-partner scores (amendment of 2026-10-24)
layer_rule: indexed units: each tradition's earliest, least derivative layer per genre (docs/research/8c-preregistration.md, Stage C-S table; scripts/build_8c_stageCS.py Classifier); idf over the indexed units only
class_rule: a partner shares at least one genre class (NARR, CULT, LAW, WISDOM, LYR) with its pivot
decoy_rule: Stage B's decoy rule within the real partner's corpus, from indexed units sharing a class with the pivot
